annotate_scale_bar_layout — ANNOTATE paper op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import annotate; annotate.annotate_scale_bar_layout(shape, units_per_pixel, unit='µm', corner='rb', target_fraction=0.2, margin=14, thickness=5) (or opsannotate.get("annotate_scale_bar_layout"))

Usage

Returns a table (dict): a bar of a round length, at most `target_fraction` of the image width.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

長さは `1/2/5 × 10^k のうち target_fraction * W * units_per_pixel` 以下の

最大値。画素長 = `round(length / units_per_pixel)`。

Returns

-------

dict

`{"length","px","rect":(x,y,w,h),"unit","corner","label"}`。

Raises

------

ValueError

units_per_pixel / target_fraction が非正、未知の corner、

バーが 1 画素未満か画像に収まらない。
